waits.coldStart: process launch → page-library shown and the resource list offers the 10 MiB TXT
waits.uiFeedback: dispatched rail click (library, chat, novel shelf) → DOM commit of the target page (4 ms polling, hidden window, no paint)
waits.largeTail: card click → the work's page → read click → DOM commit whose reading body contains the tail marker restored from stored progress
waits.saveReceipt: insertText in the note editor (opened from the records list) → data-save-state leaves and returns to saved
waits.duringParse: same UI and save samples, kept only while a 10 MiB import is still parsing

requirement.scaleColdStartToLibraryMs: 6.2 冷启动至可操作资源库 ≤ 5 s
requirement.scaleUiFeedbackP95Ms: 6.2 本地界面反馈 p95 ≤ 100 ms
requirement.scaleLargeTxtTailP95Ms: 6.2 已索引小说首屏 TXT ≤ 10 MiB p95 ≤ 2 s（恢复到末段）
requirement.scaleLargeEpubTailP95Ms: 6.2 已索引小说首屏 EPUB ≤ 30 MiB p95 ≤ 2 s（恢复到末章末段）
requirement.scaleSaveReceiptP95Ms: 6.2 自动保存：编辑草稿 ≤ 1 s
requirement.scaleDuringParseUiP95Ms: 6.2 本地界面反馈 p95 ≤ 100 ms，后台解析期间
requirement.scaleDuringParseSaveP95Ms: 6.2 自动保存 ≤ 1 s，后台解析期间

scanThroughputFilesPerS.note: one value per 5000-file scan, including the pictures and details read for the new works; recorded, not a limit

coverImageReadMs.note: reading one cover's bytes from the images table

coverHandleColdMs.note: covers.handles for one cover whose grid thumbnail is made from the images table

coverHandleWarmMs.note: covers.handles for one cover whose grid thumbnail already exists

paneScrollMs.note: setting the 1000-message list's scroll position and reading the layout, real window

paneInputMs.note: typing into the input of the right pane with 1000 messages, to the React commit and a layout read, real window

waits.scroll: set the message list's scroll position → forced layout read (hidden window: no paint)
waits.input: set the input's value and dispatch input → React commit → forced layout read

requirement.scanEventLoopP99Ms: 14.6 5000 个文件扫描：主进程事件循环延迟 p99 ≤ 100 ms
requirement.scanInteractionP95Ms: 14.6 5000 个文件扫描期间：书架与设置所用命令的响应 p95 ≤ 100 ms

notes: Indexed first screen reads an already stored revision. Reparse imports a text file again. duringParseMs is workspace.get while a worker parse is in flight. Service contentAvailableMs and saveReceiptMs remain operation receipts. Window contentAvailableMs, saveReceiptMs and importToReadableMs wait until the packaged or built Electron renderer shows the library page, the readable text, or a committed note save state. This file is a self-check, not product acceptance.
